title: phegopteris triphylla
intro: Phegopteris triphylla, commonly known as three-lobed fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to East Asia and is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits. The plant has been found to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Phegopteris triphylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
